easy: A medical method that goes inside the body by cutting or using a needle.

ex.en: The doctor chose a test that wasn't invasive, so no needles.
ex.ko: 의사는 바늘을 쓰지 않는 비침습적 검사를 골랐다.

easy: A small device made by Apple for playing music.

ex.en: Dad still has his old iPod full of songs.
ex.ko: 아빠는 노래가 가득한 옛날 아이팟을 아직도 갖고 계신다.

easy: A number from a test that is meant to show how smart a person is.

ex.en: Some people think an IQ test can't measure creativity.
ex.ko: 어떤 사람들은 아이큐 검사로 창의력을 잴 수 없다고 생각한다.

easy: A soft gray rock made of thin layers of hardened mud.

ex.en: The shale broke apart into flat pieces.
ex.ko: 셰일이 납작한 조각들로 쪼개졌다.

easy: Firing a gun or arrow.

ex.en: His shooting at the archery range was slow but careful.
ex.ko: 그는 양궁장에서 천천히 하지만 정확하게 쏘았다.

easy: A person who goes door to door asking for money, votes, or sales.

ex.en: The sign on our door says 'No solicitors.'
ex.ko: 우리 집 문에는 '방문 판매 사절'이라고 쓰여 있다.

easy: A group of soldiers on horseback made up of smaller units.

ex.en: A squadron of cavalry rode over the hill.
ex.ko: 기병 대대가 언덕을 넘어 달려왔다.

easy: A strict religious and military group that took control of Afghanistan.

ex.en: The Taliban did not allow girls to go to school.
ex.ko: 탈레반은 여자아이들이 학교에 가지 못하게 했다.

easy: Dry things like small twigs and grass used to start a fire.

ex.en: We gathered dry tinder to start the campfire.
ex.ko: 우리는 캠프파이어를 피우려고 마른 불쏘시개를 모았다.

easy: A kind of beer; only for adults.

ex.en: The pub sold ale to the grown-ups.
ex.ko: 그 술집은 어른들에게 에일을 팔았다.

easy: The direction of a star or planet measured as an angle around the horizon.

ex.en: The astronomer wrote down the star's azimuth.
ex.ko: 천문학자는 그 별의 방위각을 기록했다.

easy: A loud noise that keeps going, like hitting something again and again.

ex.en: The banging from next door kept me awake.
ex.ko: 옆집에서 쾅쾅거리는 소리에 잠을 못 잤다.

easy: A group of companies that work together on a big project.

ex.en: A consortium of companies built the new bridge.
ex.ko: 여러 회사로 이루어진 컨소시엄이 새 다리를 지었다.

easy: The highest university degree in religion.

ex.en: The pastor has a DD from a famous university.
ex.ko: 그 목사님은 유명한 대학에서 신학 박사 학위를 받으셨다.

easy: Causing great harm or very bad results.

ex.en: Forgetting the tent was disastrous on our camping trip.
ex.ko: 텐트를 깜빡한 것은 캠핑 여행에서 재앙이었다.

easy: A strong, clear alcohol drink flavored with berries; only for adults.

ex.en: Gin is a strong drink only grown-ups may have.
ex.ko: 진은 어른만 마실 수 있는 독한 술이다.

easy: The part of the British government that used to collect taxes.

ex.en: British workers paid taxes to the Inland Revenue.
ex.ko: 영국 노동자들은 국세청에 세금을 냈다.

easy: Very, very overweight in a way that is bad for health.

ex.en: The vet put the obese dog on a diet.
ex.ko: 수의사는 몹시 뚱뚱한 개에게 다이어트를 시켰다.

easy: Getting or buying things that are needed.

ex.en: She is in charge of the procurement of school supplies.
ex.ko: 그녀는 학용품 조달을 맡고 있다.

easy: A material in cells that carries messages from DNA to help make proteins.

ex.en: Scientists study RNA to learn how cells work.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 세포가 어떻게 움직이는지 알려고 RNA를 연구한다.

easy: To talk with someone over a video call on the computer.

ex.en: We Skype with Grandma in Seoul every Sunday.
ex.ko: 우리는 일요일마다 서울에 계신 할머니와 영상 통화를 한다.

easy: The direction halfway between south and west.

ex.en: The storm is moving toward the southwest.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 남서쪽으로 이동하고 있다.

easy: Hurting someone back because they hurt you.

ex.en: The hero chose kindness instead of vengeance.
ex.ko: 주인공은 복수 대신 친절을 택했다.

easy: Taking action to make changes in society, like by protesting.

ex.en: Her activism helped save the old park.
ex.ko: 그녀의 사회 운동 덕분에 오래된 공원을 지켜냈다.

easy: The four weeks before Christmas.

ex.en: We open one door of our Advent calendar every day.
ex.ko: 우리는 매일 대림절 달력의 문을 하나씩 연다.

easy: Sadly; by bad luck.

ex.en: Alas, the ice cream melted before we got home.
ex.ko: 안타깝게도 집에 오기 전에 아이스크림이 녹아 버렸다.

easy: A British title of honor, below a baron and above a knight.

ex.en: As a baronet, he was called 'Sir Henry.'
ex.ko: 그는 준남작이어서 '헨리 경'이라고 불렸다.

easy: A small valley with trees.

ex.en: We sang 'The Farmer in the Dell' in music class.
ex.ko: 우리는 음악 시간에 '골짜기의 농부' 노래를 불렀다.

easy: A unit of liquid equal to one-tenth of a liter.

ex.en: The recipe needs two deciliters of milk.
ex.ko: 그 요리법에는 우유 2데시리터가 필요하다.

easy: Learning that helps people understand things and spreads knowledge.

ex.en: Books bring enlightenment to curious minds.
ex.ko: 책은 호기심 많은 사람에게 깨우침을 준다.

easy: A fort where soldiers live to guard a place.

ex.en: The soldiers stayed in the garrison on the hill.
ex.ko: 군인들은 언덕 위 요새에 머물렀다.
